ownership.quote: Nebius AI R&D is excited to introduce ConTree — secure, forkable code sandboxes as a service, tailored for research on AI agents and now available in early access.

stage.quote: ConTree now ships as Sandboxes inside Nebius Token Factory — the platform where Nebius already serves open-weight and frontier model inference and runs fine-tuning.
stage.note: ConTree was built in-house by Nebius AI R&D (announced Feb 2026 as an internal early-access project, not a separately funded startup) and folded into Nebius Token Factory as the 'Sandboxes' product in May 2026. It has no independent cap table or funding history; the relevant funding entity is its parent, Nebius Group N.V., a Nasdaq-listed public company (ticker NBIS) that was spun off from Yandex N.V. in 2024.
